options.label: Any%
options.rule:
Go to credits without using major glitches as fast as possible.

The following things are considered major glitches:
- Zips
- Rewind Tricks
- First Person glitches
- Boosts
- Invisible sword glitch
- Invisible ledges
- Zombie Glitch
- Trap fall damage cancel
- Enemy clipping
- Ledge storage
- Canceling a wallrun by pausing

Check the glitch guide for detailed explanation of each glitch - https://www.speedrun.com/pop_sot/guide/6lrg7

subcategories.label: No Major Glitches
subcategories.rule: The use of major glitches prohibited. Major Glitches - https://www.speedrun.com/pop_sot/guide/6lrg7

subcategories.rule: The use of zips is prohibited.
